description_blocks.text: Introduction

This Handheld Vacuum Cleaner Kit offers versatile expandability, adapting to diverse scenarios through interchangeable components. Whether within the print chamber, on the optical shaft lead screw, or in desktop crevices, maintaining tidiness proves effortless and convenient. Users may freely design custom enclosures according to unique preferences and requirements, or obtain a wide variety of printed casings from MakerWorld to achieve personalised appearance customisation.

Creator Program: The Creator Program is a collaborative program between Bambu Lab and creators. Creators unleash their creativity to design 3D printing models, while Bambu Lab provides compatible hardware kits for those designs.
Note: This model may require additional Maker's Supply parts for full assembly. Please check the model link for the complete BOM list.
Frequently Asked Questions
The gear memory function enhances user convenience. Specifically:
On first power-on after battery connection, the device defaults to the highest gear (Gear 3).
If powered on again without disconnecting the battery, it resumes the gear setting used before shutdown.
If the battery is disconnected and reconnected, the next power-on will again default to Gear 3.
1. When the voltage drops below the level required for normal motor operation:
The white LED blinks slowly for 30 seconds, then the device shuts down automatically.
During these 30 seconds: Long press--powers off immediately; Short press--switches gear (if applicable).
2. After a low-battery shutdown, upon attempting to power on again:
If voltage meets the startup threshold, the motor starts—but if low voltage persists, the alert repeats.
If voltage is still too low, the motor won’t start, and neither the light nor buttons respond.
If a motor fault is detected (e.g., persistent air duct blockage or phase loss):
The motor stops immediately, and the white LED flashes rapidly for 30 seconds before turning off.
During this period: Long press--turns off the LED immediately; Short press--no response.
If the fault persists after reboot, the motor will not start, and the same alert sequence repeats.
When using the vacuum on tightly sealed surfaces like leather, car seats, or upholstery, the intake may become partially blocked, reducing airflow.
Since the motor relies on this airflow for cooling, please occasionally lift the vacuum during use to ensure adequate ventilation and prevent overheating.

Although this product is suitable for in-car use, its built-in lithium battery is sensitive to high temperatures. For safety reasons, we recommend not leaving it unattended in enclosed, hot environments —such as a vehicle parked in direct sunlight—to minimize the risk of battery overheating, swelling, or other hazards.
